properties_with_code.text: After distributed blob publishing, imported columns must behave as if received via gossip.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall col from EL: imported(col) => treated_as_gossip(col) == true

properties_with_code.text: data_column_serve_range lower bound must be max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH).
properties_with_code.assertion: serve_range.start == max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH)

properties_with_code.text: blob_sidecars_by_range must be fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS.
properties_with_code.assertion: current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => respond_empty_or_reject

properties_with_code.text: During transition, blob_sidecars_by_range must serve only pre-Fulu epoch blobs.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar in transition_resp: compute_epoch(sidecar.slot) < FULU_FORK_EPOCH

properties_with_code.text: Peers must not be penalized for requesting blob sidecars from FULU_FORK_EPOCH during transition.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall req at FULU_FORK_EPOCH: peer_score_delta(req.peer) >= 0

properties_with_code.text: BPO forks must not change next_fork_version, only next_fork_epoch in ENR eth2 field.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall bpo_fork: enr.next_fork_version == current_fork_version && enr.next_fork_epoch == planned_epoch

properties_with_code.text: ENR eth2 epoch must be determined by wall-clock time, not sync state.
properties_with_code.assertion: enr_epoch == wall_clock_epoch() regardless of sync_state

properties_with_code.text: blob_sidecars_by_root must be fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS.
properties_with_code.assertion: current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => respond_empty_or_reject

properties_with_code.text: Publishing data columns must only occur on subnets the node is subscribed to (custody/sampling).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall col: published(col, subnet) => subscribed(subnet, custody) || subscribed(subnet, sampling)

properties_with_code.text: verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch must receive consistent-length arrays for valid verification.
properties_with_code.assertion: len(commitments) == len(cell_indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs)

properties_with_code.text: max_blobs_per_block must be epoch-dependent via get_blob_parameters (EIP-7892).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall e1 != e2: get_blob_parameters(e1).max_blobs may differ from get_blob_parameters(e2).max_blobs

properties_with_code.text: Gossip validation IGNORE must not forward but allow later re-processing of the message.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall msg: ignored(msg) => not_forwarded(msg) && reprocessable(msg)

properties_with_code.text: Gossip validation must ignore sidecars with slot in the future (slot > current_slot).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar: sidecar.slot > current_slot => ignored(sidecar)

properties_with_code.text: Gossip validation must ignore sidecars at or before finalized checkpoint start slot.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar: sidecar.slot <= compute_start_slot_at_epoch(finalized_epoch) => ignored(sidecar)

properties_with_code.text: Cached blob params must be invalidated at epoch boundaries where get_blob_parameters changes.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall epoch_boundary: cached_max_blobs(epoch) == get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block

properties_with_code.text: Any optimized KZG verification path must produce same accept/reject as unoptimized batch verify.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall input: optimized_kzg_verify(input) == verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch(input)

properties_with_code.text: Any cached/optimized inclusion proof verification must match full Merkle branch verification.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall proof: optimized_merkle_verify(proof) == is_valid_merkle_branch(proof)

properties_with_code.text: After fork transition, any derived state depending on pre-fork config must be refreshed.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall derived_state: depends_on(derived_state, fork_config) => refreshed_after_fork(derived_state)

properties_with_code.text: All sidecars of a block must be included in by_range response if any sidecar is included.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall block, resp: any_sidecar_included(block, resp) => all_sidecars_included(block, resp)

properties_with_code.text: distributed_blob_publishing must abort if not ALL blobs matching kzg_commitments are retrieved.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall publish: not all_blobs_retrieved(commitments) => abort_publishing()

properties_with_code.text: Declared commitment count in block header must equal actual blob commitments attached.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall block: block.header.commitment_count == len(block.blob_kzg_commitments) || reject(block)

properties_with_code.text: Cached proposer index must be authoritative for current slot; recomputation must not diverge.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall slot: cached_proposer(slot) != None => use cached_proposer(slot), not recompute_proposer(state)

properties_with_code.text: Fiat-Shamir challenge hash must include all verifier-relevant inputs to prevent selective forgery.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall batch_verify(comms, cells, proofs, idx): hash_input contains DOMAIN || BLOB_SIZE || CELL_SIZE || len(comms) || len(idx) || comms || idx || evals || proofs

properties_with_code.text: Batch KZG verification pairing equation must hold: e(LL, LR) == e(RL, G2) for valid proofs.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall valid(cells, proofs, comms): pairing_check([[g1_lincomb(proofs, r_powers), KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL[n]], [RL, neg(G2)]]) == true

properties_with_code.text: Commitment deduplication must preserve semantic equivalence — mapping indices must be bijective per unique commitment.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall dedup(comms_bytes): forall i,j: comms_bytes[i] == comms_bytes[j] <=> commitment_indices[i] == commitment_indices[j]

properties_with_code.text: All cell_indices must be validated < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB before use in verification or recovery.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall verify_batch(cell_indices): forall idx in cell_indices: 0 <= idx < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties_with_code.text: All input list lengths must be equal before batch verification proceeds.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall verify_batch(comms, indices, cells, proofs): len(comms) == len(indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs)

properties_with_code.text: Each commitment byte array must be exactly BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT length before deserialization.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall verify_batch(comms_bytes): forall c in comms_bytes: len(c) == BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT

properties_with_code.text: Each cell must be exactly BYTES_PER_CELL length; each proof must be BYTES_PER_PROOF length.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall verify_batch(cells, proofs): forall c in cells: len(c) == BYTES_PER_CELL AND forall p in proofs: len(p) == BYTES_PER_PROOF

properties_with_code.text: Recovery requires at least CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB/2 cells (50% erasure coding threshold).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices, cells): len(cell_indices) >= CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB / 2

properties_with_code.text: Recovery cell_indices must be unique and sorted in ascending order.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices): is_sorted(cell_indices) AND is_unique(cell_indices)

properties_with_code.text: Recovered polynomial must have degree < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB (truncation correctness).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices, cells) -> poly: deg(poly) < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB

properties_with_code.text: Coset division in recovery must use coset shift to avoid division by zero on vanishing polynomial roots.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover: division_of(ez, zp) is computed over coset domain, not FFT domain where Z(x)==0

properties_with_code.text: Vanishing polynomial must evaluate to zero at all missing cell evaluation points and nonzero elsewhere.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall construct_vanishing(missing): forall x in missing_coset_points: Z(x) == 0 AND forall x in present_coset_points: Z(x) != 0

properties_with_code.text: Coset shift for each cell must use bit-reversal permuted roots at correct stride offset.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall cell_index: coset_shift_for_cell(cell_index) == bit_reversal_permutation(roots_of_unity(FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB))[FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index]

properties_with_code.text: cell_to_coset_evals and coset_evals_to_cell must be exact inverses for valid field elements.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall cell: coset_evals_to_cell(cell_to_coset_evals(cell)) == cell

properties_with_code.text: FFT input length must be a power of 2; mismatched lengths cause incorrect butterfly computation.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall _fft_field(vals, roots): is_power_of_2(len(vals)) AND len(vals) == len(roots)

properties_with_code.text: Inverse FFT must apply normalization factor 1/N and reverse roots order (except first element).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall fft_field(vals, roots, inv=True): result == [x * (1/len(vals)) for x in _fft_field(vals, reverse(roots[1:]))]

properties_with_code.text: Polynomial multiplication result degree must not exceed FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB - 1.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall multiply(a, b): len(a) + len(b) - 1 <= FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties_with_code.text: Polynomial division divisor must not be the zero polynomial (leading coefficient nonzero).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall divide(a, b): b != [0] AND b[len(b)-1] != 0

properties_with_code.text: Lagrange interpolation requires all x-coordinates to be distinct for invertibility.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall interpolate(xs, ys): forall i != j: xs[i] != xs[j]

properties_with_code.text: Interpolated polynomial must evaluate to ys[i] at xs[i] for all input points.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall interpolate(xs, ys) -> p: forall i: evaluate(p, xs[i]) == ys[i]

properties_with_code.text: KZG multi-proof quotient Q(X) must satisfy f(X) = Q(X)*Z(X) + R(X) where R vanishes on evaluation points.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall compute_kzg_proof_multi(poly, zs): forall z in zs: evaluate(poly, z) == evaluate(remainder, z)

properties_with_code.text: Bit-reversal permutation must be applied before inverse FFT in polynomial_eval_to_coeff.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall polynomial_eval_to_coeff(poly): applies bit_reversal_permutation(poly) before fft_field(inv=True)

properties_with_code.text: Blob input must be exactly BYTES_PER_BLOB before cell computation or proof generation.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs(blob): len(blob) == BYTES_PER_BLOB

properties_with_code.text: compute_cells must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cells from a valid blob.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall compute_cells(blob) -> cells: len(cells) == CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties_with_code.text: Each cell-proof pair from compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs must individually pass verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs(blob) -> (cells, proofs): verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch(commit(blob), range(CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB), cells, proofs) == true

properties_with_code.text: Recovered cells and proofs must be identical to originally computed cells and proofs for the same blob.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall blob, subset >= 50%: recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs(subset) == compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs(blob)

properties_with_code.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all cell data, proofs, and indices from peers must be fully validated.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall peer_message(cells, proofs, indices): validated(cells) AND validated(proofs) AND validated(indices) before use

properties_with_code.text: Engine API blob data is semi-trusted; blobs from EL must still pass KZG commitment verification.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall blob from EL: verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob, commitment) == true before propagation
